name: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT)
dormSituation: Severe dorm shortage. Graduate dorm lottery success rate is only ~30%. University-managed family/spouse housing has an 8–14 month waitlist. Over 75% of graduate and married students live off-campus in Cambridge, Somerville, or Boston.

areas.name: Kendall Square
areas.commuteType: Walking / MIT Campus Shuttle
areas.description: Right on MIT campus border. World-renowned biotech & tech hub. Modern luxury high-rises with 24/7 security, but highest rental rates in Cambridge.
areas.groceryOptions: Target Central (10 min), Whole Foods (River St), Brothers Marketplace

transportation.details: MBTA CharlieCard LinkPass ($90/mo per person) covers subway & bus.

healthMisc.details: MIT Student Health Insurance Plan (SHIP) + spouse dependent coverage.

areas.name: Central Square
areas.commuteType: 12 min walk / Red Line (1 stop) / Bus #1
areas.description: Top choice for MIT students. Bustling cultural hub along Massachusetts Ave with affordable grocery stores, South Asian & halal eateries, and red-line subway access.
areas.groceryOptions: H-Mart (Asian/Halal essentials), Target, Daily Table (discount groceries), Shalimar India Groceries

transportation.details: Direct walk or 1 stop on MBTA Red Line from Central to Kendall/MIT.

areas.name: East Cambridge / Inman
areas.commuteType: 15 min walk / EZRide Shuttle / Green Line
areas.description: Charming, quieter historic residential neighborhood north of Kendall. Great multi-family houses with porches, highly favored by international couples and postdocs.
areas.groceryOptions: Star Market (Twin City Plaza), Mayflower Market, Cambridge Street delis

transportation.details: Often walkable/bikeable; EZRide shuttle connects free with MIT ID.

areas.name: Somerville (Union Sq / Davis Sq)
areas.commuteType: 15 min via MBTA Red Line or Green Line D/E branch
areas.description: The quintessential graduate student enclave. Vibrant arts scene, safe tree-lined avenues, and significantly more spacious apartments. Best value for couples.
areas.groceryOptions: Market Basket (huge savings for monthly groceries!), Trader Joe's, Target Somerville

transportation.details: Direct transit via Union Sq (Green Line) or Davis (Red Line).

areas.name: Allston / Brighton (Boston)
areas.commuteType: 20 min via MBTA Bus #66 or #1 / 15 min bike ride across river
areas.description: Lively student-centric Boston neighborhood across the Charles River. Lowest rent in the immediate metro area with abundant Asian bakeries, halal butchers, and Korean dining.
areas.groceryOptions: Super 88 Asian Supermarket, Stop & Shop, Trader Joe's Allston, Baza Gourmet

transportation.details: Bus #66 directly to Harvard/MIT or Bluebikes annual pass ($40/yr).

name: Harvard University
dormSituation: Harvard Yard and College Houses are exclusively reserved for undergrads. Graduate schools (HKS, HBS, GSAS, Harvard Law, SEAS) rely on lottery-based HUH housing where less than 25% get spots. Off-campus private rental is standard.

areas.name: Harvard Square
areas.commuteType: Direct Walking
areas.description: Historic epicenter of Harvard. Walk directly to Widener Library, Yard, and Law School. Premium rents but unmatched convenience.
areas.groceryOptions: Broadway Marketplace, Trader Joe's (Memorial Dr), Cardullo's Gourmet

transportation.details: Almost 100% walkable to all Harvard facilities.

areas.name: Porter Square
areas.commuteType: 1 stop Red Line / 15 min walk north along Mass Ave
areas.description: Peaceful neighborhood with Japanese shopping plaza, large supermarkets, and express commuter rail/subway access. Very popular for graduate couples.
areas.groceryOptions: Star Market (24 hours), Maruichi Japanese Market, Target Porter

transportation.details: MBTA Red Line direct 3-minute ride into Harvard Station.

areas.name: Lower Allston (SEC Campus)
areas.commuteType: 10 min walk to SEAS / Free Harvard Crimson Shuttle
areas.description: Adjacent to Harvard Business School and the new Science & Engineering Complex (SEC). Spacious apartments with backyards, quiet residential feel.
areas.groceryOptions: Trader Joe's (Cambridge St), Star Market Allston, Baza Supermarket

transportation.details: Free Harvard inter-campus shuttle connects SEC to Harvard Yard.

name: Stanford University
dormSituation: Subsidized on-campus graduate housing (EVGR) has strict caps and multi-tier lotteries. Married/couple housing is limited. Silicon Valley rental market surrounding campus is among the most competitive in the world.

areas.name: Downtown Palo Alto
areas.commuteType: Free Stanford Marguerite Shuttle / 8 min bike
areas.description: Upscale tree-shaded Silicon Valley center. High-end dining along University Ave, Caltrain connection, tech offices, and leafy residential streets.
areas.groceryOptions: Trader Joe's (Town & Country Village), Whole Foods Palo Alto, Safeway

transportation.details: Free Marguerite shuttle covers all campus routes; bicycles are the primary transit.

healthMisc.details: Stanford Cardinal Care student health insurance.

areas.name: Menlo Park
areas.commuteType: 12 min bike ride / Marguerite Line B
areas.description: Bordering Stanford to the north. Quiet residential pockets, excellent schools, and peaceful leafy avenues favored by postdocs and couples with spouses.
areas.groceryOptions: Trader Joe's Menlo Park, Safeway, Draeger's Market

transportation.details: Caltrain to Palo Alto + Marguerite shuttle.

areas.name: Mountain View (Castro St)
areas.commuteType: 15 min Caltrain direct ride to Palo Alto + Shuttle
areas.description: Vibrant tech city (home of Googleplex). Pedestrian-friendly Castro Street dining, farmers markets, and more modern apartment communities with swimming pools and gyms.
areas.groceryOptions: 99 Ranch Market, Sprouts Farmers Market, Safeway Mountain View

transportation.details: Caltrain monthly commuter pass (Zone 3 to Zone 3).

name: University of California, Berkeley
dormSituation: Berkeley has the lowest on-campus housing percentage in the entire UC system. Dorms cover only ~22% of students. Over 78% rent apartments in Southside, Downtown Berkeley, Northside, or Oakland.

areas.name: Downtown Berkeley
areas.commuteType: 6 min walk to West Gate / BART station
areas.description: Modern urban center west of campus. Features the Downtown Berkeley BART subway station, movie theatres, multi-ethnic eateries, and mid-rise student apartment complexes.
areas.groceryOptions: Trader Joe's (University Ave), Target Downtown Berkeley, Berkeley Bowl (famous produce market)

transportation.details: Free AC Transit EasyPass with Cal 1 Card for students.

areas.name: Northside / Gourmet Ghetto
areas.commuteType: 8 min walk to College of Engineering & Chemistry
areas.description: Quiet, leafy, and highly safe neighborhood directly north of the engineering and science facilities. Renowned culinary cradle of farm-to-table dining (Chez Panisse). Highly sought after by graduate couples.
areas.groceryOptions: Safeway Shattuck Ave, Andronico's Community Markets, North Berkeley grocers

transportation.details: Walking distance to North Gate campus entrances.

areas.name: North Oakland / Rockridge
areas.commuteType: 10 min direct ride on AC Transit Bus #51B or BART
areas.description: Charming, safe residential enclave south of Berkeley. Excellent College Ave shopping district, craft bakeries, and garden apartments with easy bus commute to campus.
areas.groceryOptions: Market Hall Foods, Trader Joe's Rockridge, Safeway Broadway

transportation.details: Direct AC Transit #51B bus ride to campus terminal.

name: New York University (NYU)
dormSituation: NYU dorms are among the most expensive in the US ($22k+/yr) with graduate priority severely capped. Over 80% of graduate and married students rent in East Village, Brooklyn, or Jersey City.

areas.name: Greenwich Village
areas.commuteType: Immediate Campus Walk
areas.description: Around Washington Square Park. Historic brownstones and cobblestone lanes. Ultra-convenient, top Manhattan prestige.
areas.groceryOptions: Trader Joe's (6th Ave), Morton Williams, Westside Market

transportation.details: 100% walkable to all NYU buildings.

areas.name: East Village / LES
areas.commuteType: 12 min walk / Astor Pl Subway (6 train)
areas.description: Legendary bohemian student hub. Vibrant street culture, budget izakayas, bagel shops, and walkup apartments.
areas.groceryOptions: Trader Joe's 14th St, Target East Village, Key Food

transportation.details: Walkable or MTA MetroCard subway.

areas.name: Jersey City (Journal Sq / Newport)
areas.commuteType: 15-20 min via PATH train directly to 9th St / W 4th St (NYU)
areas.description: Top lifehack for NYU couples! Across the Hudson River. Spacious modern 1BHK/2BHKs with in-unit washer/dryer at 40% lower rent than Manhattan.
areas.groceryOptions: India Square (massive halal/desi grocery hub), ShopRite, ACME

transportation.details: PATH SmartLink card ($2.75/ride, 15 min into Manhattan W 4th St).

name: Columbia University
dormSituation: Upper Manhattan Columbia Residential manages faculty & grad housing with long waitlists. Many students rent in Morningside Heights, Harlem, and Washington Heights.

areas.name: Morningside Heights
areas.commuteType: Immediate Campus Walking
areas.description: Picturesque academic neighborhood surrounding the main Low Memorial Library campus and Riverside Park. Pre-war elevator buildings with high ceilings.
areas.groceryOptions: Westside Market (Broadway), Morton Williams, H Mart Morningside Heights

transportation.details: Walking distance to all Morningside campus facilities.

areas.name: Central Harlem / South Harlem
areas.commuteType: 12 min walk across Morningside Park / Bus M4/M11
areas.description: Vibrant historic cultural neighborhood with iconic brownstones, soul food, and significantly more affordable rental pricing than southern Manhattan.
areas.groceryOptions: Whole Foods 125th St, Fine Fare Supermarket, Lincoln Market

transportation.details: Walkable or quick 1-stop subway / bus ride.

areas.name: Washington Heights
areas.commuteType: 12 min direct subway on 1 Train or A Train
areas.description: Dominican cultural heart of northern Manhattan. Hilltop parks, views of the Hudson, very close to Columbia University Irving Medical Center (CUIMC).
areas.groceryOptions: Super Foodtown, Key Food, Associated Supermarkets

transportation.details: Direct 1 Train to 116th St Columbia University station.

name: University of Toronto (St. George)
dormSituation: Residence space is critically constrained in Downtown Toronto. First-year dorm guarantee does not cover graduate students or students with spouses. Over 85% live off-campus in nearby GTA neighborhoods.

areas.name: The Annex
areas.commuteType: 8 min walk to campus core / Bloor-Danforth Subway
areas.description: The quintessential U of T student enclave. Tree-lined streets lined with historic Victorian houses divided into cozy apartments, indie bookstores, and late-night cafes.
areas.groceryOptions: Metro Bloor St, Whole Foods Yorkville, Fiesta Farms (organic/produce)

transportation.details: Walkable; TTC monthly pass C$128 optional if commuting.

healthMisc.details: UHIP (University Health Insurance Plan) mandatory for internationals.

areas.name: Chinatown & Kensington Market
areas.commuteType: 10 min walk / 510 Spadina Streetcar
areas.description: Directly south of campus along Spadina Ave. Most affordable fresh produce, seafood, South Asian spices, and discount bakeries in central Toronto.
areas.groceryOptions: Lucky Moose Food Mart, Hua Sheng Supermarket, Kensington produce stalls

transportation.details: Walkable or TTC 510 streetcar right up Spadina to campus.

areas.name: East York / Scarborough Belt
areas.commuteType: 35 min via TTC Line 2 or GO Train into Union Station
areas.description: High-value choice for students accompanied by spouse/family. Huge South Asian diaspora, halal markets everywhere (Banglatown on Danforth Ave), and larger 2BHKs.
areas.groceryOptions: Iqbal Foods, FreshCo, No Frills Danforth, Al-Madina Halal Meat

transportation.details: TTC Monthly Pass gives unlimited subway, streetcar, and bus.

name: University of British Columbia (UBC)
dormSituation: UBC campus housing waitlist regularly exceeds 6,000 students. Point Grey campus is perched on a scenic peninsula, and majority of students live in Kitsilano, Dunbar, or East Vancouver.

areas.name: Kitsilano (Kits)
areas.commuteType: 15 min express bus (#99 B-Line or #4 / #84)
areas.description: Vancouver's premier beach and student neighborhood. Famous for ocean views, Kits Beach, yoga studios, organic grocers, and relaxed west coast lifestyle.
areas.groceryOptions: Whole Foods Kitsilano, No Frills 4th Ave, Safeway Kitsilano

transportation.details: UBC U-Pass BC (C$45/mo mandatory student fee covers all TransLink transit).

areas.name: Dunbar-Southlands
areas.commuteType: 10 min direct bus (#25 or #33) or easy bike ride
areas.description: Quiet, leafy single-family residential community just east of campus. Many homeowners rent basement suites or upper floor 1BHKs to graduate students and couples.
areas.groceryOptions: Save-On-Foods, Stong's Market, local Dunbar bakeries

transportation.details: U-Pass BC gives unlimited SkyTrain, SeaBus, and bus.

areas.name: Commercial-Broadway / East Van
areas.commuteType: Direct 30 min ride on the #99 B-Line Express Bus
areas.description: Eclectic, artsy multicultural hub. High density of international food markets, Italian cafes, Latin bakeries, and more budget-friendly apartment options.
areas.groceryOptions: Superstore, Norman's Fruit & Salad, Famous Foods, halal meat markets

transportation.details: 99 B-Line express runs every 3-5 minutes during peak hours.

name: McGill University
dormSituation: McGill guarantees residences only to incoming first-year undergrads. Nearly 80% of student body lives in Montreal's vibrant, highly affordable student apartments in the 'McGill Ghetto' or Plateau.

areas.name: Milton-Parc (McGill Ghetto)
areas.commuteType: Direct Campus Walking
areas.description: Directly adjacent to McGill lower campus gates. Victorian row-houses with spiral staircases, dense student population, and buzzing social atmosphere.
areas.groceryOptions: Metro Avenue du Parc, Provigo, Eden (organic), Marché Lobo (Middle Eastern/Halal)

transportation.details: 100% walkable to campus; STM Metro pass C$58 optional.

healthMisc.details: International Student Health Insurance Plan (Medavie Blue Cross).

areas.name: Plateau-Mont-Royal
areas.commuteType: 15 min scenic walk past Mount Royal / BIXI Bike
areas.description: Montreal's coolest neighborhood. Street murals, legendary bagel bakeries (St-Viateur & Fairmount), indie boutiques, and tree-lined residential tranquility.
areas.groceryOptions: Intermarché Boyer, Segal's Market (famous Montreal discount grocery!), PA Nature

transportation.details: BIXI bike share seasonal pass or STM metro.

areas.name: Côte-des-Neiges
areas.commuteType: 20 min via Metro Blue Line or Bus #165 directly to Guy-Concordia / McGill
areas.description: Multicultural neighborhood with heavy student presence, vibrant Bangladeshi and South Asian community, very low rental costs, and large 2-bedroom units.
areas.groceryOptions: Plaza Côte-des-Neiges, Marché Jean-Talon nearby, Halal butchers, Walmart Supercentre

transportation.details: STM Student Monthly MetroPass C$58.

name: Technical University of Munich (TUM)
dormSituation: Munich student housing waitlists (Studentenwerk) are 3 to 5 semesters long. Nearly 90% of international students must secure a private WG (flatshare) room or private apartment.

areas.name: Maxvorstadt
areas.commuteType: Direct Campus Walking / U-Bahn U2 Theresienstraße
areas.description: Munich's Museum and University district. High student density, bookshops, beer gardens, and lively vibe. Very high competition for rooms.
areas.groceryOptions: Rewe City, Edeka, Netto, Asian Supermarket Karlstraße

transportation.details: Bavarian Student Deutschlandticket (€29/month gives unlimited public transit in Germany!).

healthMisc.details: Public statutory health insurance (TK / AOK for students).

areas.name: Schwabing (West & North)
areas.commuteType: 10 min bike ride / U-Bahn U3/U6
areas.description: Prestigious bohemian district next to the English Garden. Safe, green, with upscale boutiques and quiet residential pockets for married researchers.
areas.groceryOptions: Aldi Süd (great budget options), Lidl, Bio Company, Alnatura

transportation.details: Deutschlandticket (€29/mo) covers U-Bahn, tram, buses.

areas.name: Garching bei München (Science Campus)
areas.commuteType: Direct U-Bahn U6 to Garching-Forschungszentrum
areas.description: Modern university town home to TUM Engineering, CS, Physics & Math faculties. Clean, quiet, suburban community surrounded by green fields. Best for couples in STEM.
areas.groceryOptions: Penny, Edeka Garching, Rewe, Turkish Halal Market

transportation.details: U6 line connects directly to Munich city center.

name: RWTH Aachen University
dormSituation: Studierendenwerk Aachen dorms have waitlists of 1–2 years. However, private housing in Aachen is significantly more affordable than Munich or Frankfurt.

areas.name: Pontviertel / Center
areas.commuteType: Direct Walking to SuperC & Main Building
areas.description: Aachen's legendary student heart along Pontstraße. Bars, kebab spots, cafes, and historic townhouses right next to RWTH Central Campus.
areas.groceryOptions: Rewe Pontstraße, Netto, Asian Supermarket Karlsgraben

transportation.details: Free NRW SemesterTicket included in student fee covers all regional trains in NRW.

areas.name: Aachen-West / Melaten
areas.commuteType: 10 min walk to Melaten High-Tech Research Campus
areas.description: Modern engineering and medical campus area (near Uniklinik RWTH). Purpose-built student dorms and modern apartments for researchers and couples.
areas.groceryOptions: Aldi Süd Vaalser Straße, Kaufland Aachen, Turkish Halal butchers

transportation.details: Free SemesterTicket on ASEAG buses.

name: University of Oxford
dormSituation: Colleges provide accommodation for single undergraduates, but partner/family college flats are exceedingly rare (only 1-2 per college). Private renting is mandatory for students accompanied by spouses.

areas.name: Jericho
areas.commuteType: 10 min walk to Science Area and Radcliffe Humanities
areas.description: Historic canal-side suburb with artisan bakeries, cinema, and Victorian cottages. Immediate proximity to the University Science Area, Radcliffe Observatory, and Somerville College.
areas.groceryOptions: Co-op Food Jericho, Little Waitrose, Jericho Cheese Company

transportation.details: Primarily walking and bicycling (Oxford is the cycling capital of the UK).

healthMisc.details: NHS Immigration Health Surcharge (IHS) covers healthcare.

areas.name: Cowley Road & East Oxford
areas.commuteType: 15 min walk or 8 min ride via Oxford Bus Co / Stagecoach
areas.description: The dynamic multicultural heartbeat of Oxford. Packed with Bangladeshi, Pakistani, and Turkish food markets, spice stores, and indie music venues. Most student-friendly prices in town.
areas.groceryOptions: Tesco Metro, Sainsbury's Local, Continental Stores (Halal/South Asian groceries), Tahmid Halal Butchers

transportation.details: Oxford SmartZone monthly bus pass (£49/mo) or easy bike ride.

areas.name: Headington
areas.commuteType: 15-20 min direct bus (#8, #9, #280) / 12 min bike ride
areas.description: Leafy residential hilltop district home to Churchill Hospital and Oxford Brookes. High concentration of self-contained purpose-built 1-bedroom flats ideal for couples.
areas.groceryOptions: Waitrose Headington, Sainsbury's, Iceland, local grocers

transportation.details: Oxford SmartZone bus pass gives unlimited travel across the city.

name: University of Cambridge
dormSituation: Most colleges provide 1 year of single student room accommodation. Family housing through the University Accommodation Service has long waiting queues. Most couples rent in Mill Road, Chesterton, or Eddington.

areas.name: Mill Road / Romsey
areas.commuteType: 6 min bike ride or 15 min walk to town center
areas.description: Cambridge's most bohemian and cosmopolitan street. Vibrant international eateries, halal supermarkets, Indian spice shops, independent cafes, and Victorian terraces.
areas.groceryOptions: Al-Amin Halal Supermarket, Cho Mee Asian Groceries, Co-op Mill Rd, Sainsbury's

transportation.details: Bicycle is king in Cambridge (flat terrain, bike racks everywhere).

areas.name: North West Cambridge (Eddington)
areas.commuteType: 10 min bike / Free 'Universal' bus with Cambridge University Card
areas.description: Brand-new sustainable university neighborhood designed specifically for postgraduates, staff, and postdocs. Ultra energy-efficient modern apartments, community gardens, and school.
areas.groceryOptions: Sainsbury's Eddington (large modern supermarket), Storey's Field Centre

transportation.details: University 'Universal' bus connects Eddington to West Cambridge and city center.

name: Imperial College London
dormSituation: South Kensington campus has essentially ZERO postgrad dorms. Over 90% of graduate students and couples rent in Shepherd's Bush, Hammersmith, or Acton.

areas.name: Shepherd's Bush / White City
areas.commuteType: 15 min ride on Central Line / Bus #49 or #72 directly to South Kensington
areas.description: Home to Imperial's new White City Innovation Campus. Westfield London (Europe's largest shopping mall), Shepherd's Bush Market (halal meat and produce), very high student population.
areas.groceryOptions: Westfield Supermarkets, Shepherd's Bush Market, Lidl, Tesco Extra

transportation.details: TfL 18+ Student Oyster Card gives 30% discount on Zone 1-2 travelcards.

areas.name: Hammersmith / Fulham
areas.commuteType: 15 min direct ride on Piccadilly Line to South Kensington
areas.description: Safe, lively West London transit hub along the River Thames. Excellent tube connections, shopping malls, riverside pubs, and handsome Victorian flats.
areas.groceryOptions: Kings Mall, Marks & Spencer, Sainsbury's, Polish & Middle Eastern delis

transportation.details: TfL Student Oyster travelcard.

name: University of Melbourne
dormSituation: Parkville campus colleges are cost-prohibitive for most students ($25k–$35k/year). Most international postgrads and couples rent in Carlton, Brunswick, or North Melbourne.

areas.name: Carlton / Lygon Street
areas.commuteType: Immediate Campus Walking / Swanston St Trams
areas.description: Melbourne's 'Little Italy' bordering campus. Coffee culture capital, Italian trattorias, bookstores, Carlton Gardens, and heritage terrace houses.
areas.groceryOptions: Woolworths Carlton, Brunetti, Queen Victoria Market (10 min walk for fresh food!)

transportation.details: Within walking distance or Free Tram Zone in CBD.

areas.name: Brunswick / Sydney Road
areas.commuteType: 15 min direct ride on Tram #19 down Sydney Rd to campus
areas.description: Creative hipster hub famous for live music, vintage shops, Middle Eastern halal bakeries, and significantly more affordable rental pricing.
areas.groceryOptions: Coles Brunswick, Barkly Square, A1 Bakery (Halal), Mediterranean Wholesalers

transportation.details: PTV myki Monthly Pass (Zone 1-2).

name: University of Sydney
dormSituation: Camperdown/Darlington on-campus residential colleges have steep fees and long waitlists. Over 80% of students rent off-campus in Newtown, Glebe, or Chippendale.

areas.name: Newtown / King Street
areas.commuteType: 8 min walk to Camperdown campus
areas.description: Bohemian student mecca along King Street. Vibrant live music, vegan and halal eateries, vintage bookstores, and charming Victorian terrace houses.
areas.groceryOptions: Woolworths Newtown, IGA Newtown, Foodworks, Halal butchers

transportation.details: Walkable to campus; Opal card for Sydney buses/trains.

areas.name: Glebe
areas.commuteType: 6 min walk across Victoria Park to Quadrangle
areas.description: Historic, leafy suburb overlooking Blackwattle Bay and Sydney Harbour. Renowned weekend markets, cafes, quiet residential streets, popular with postgrads.
areas.groceryOptions: Glebe Markets, Broadway Shopping Centre (huge mall with Kmart, Target, Coles, Harris Farm)

transportation.details: Easy walk across Victoria Park to campus.

name: National University of Singapore (NUS)
dormSituation: Kent Ridge campus residential halls (UTown) prioritize freshmen and scholarship awardees. Private HDB (Housing Development Board) flats and condominiums in Clementi or West Coast house the majority of international grad couples.

areas.name: Clementi Town
areas.commuteType: 10 min direct ride on Bus #96 / #151 to NUS Kent Ridge Terminal
areas.description: The primary residential town for NUS. High concentration of affordable HDB flats, 24-hour hawker centers, Clementi Mall, and direct MRT East-West line access.
areas.groceryOptions: FairPrice Clementi Mall, Sheng Siong Supermarket, 448 Clementi Market & Food Centre

transportation.details: EZ-Link / SimplyGo card gives subsidised bus and MRT rates.

healthMisc.details: NUS Group Personal Accident and Medical Insurance Scheme.

areas.name: West Coast / Pasir Panjang
areas.commuteType: 10 min walk or direct bus (#30, #51, #143, #175)
areas.description: Quiet coastal residential belt south of campus. Modern private condominiums, West Coast Plaza, and sea breezes. Highly favored by married research fellows.
areas.groceryOptions: Cold Storage West Coast Plaza, Sheng Siong, West Coast Market Square

transportation.details: Direct bus or bicycle to Engineering and Science faculties.
